title: Add GESP selection/judgment routes and keep programming in workbench
action: Add filtered selection/judgment navigation and API support while preserving programming question behavior in the existing GESP workbench.
implementation: Add `选择题` and `判断题` menu entries under the GESP group.
Add filtered routes that reuse current level selector, detail panel and return-context behavior with a `question_type` filter.
Extend the catalog API to support type-scoped list queries or client-side filtered views backed by the same catalog model.
Ensure programming questions continue to show under algorithm-domain cards and retain IDE launch actions.
verification_notes: Frontend build passes after adding navigation and filtered GESP routes.
API build passes after adding question_type filtering.
Service-level integration validation confirms selection filter and programming-domain placement.
HTTP-level validation against a running local Nest API confirms `/api/catalog/levels/:level?question_type=...&source_kind=wanjuanwang_exam` works for WanJuanWang data.
